requirements.text: * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* Strong programming skills in Python (preferred) or Go/Java, with foundational understanding of machine learning, NLP, or LLM architectures.
* Familiarity with frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or LangChain.
* 0\-1 years of professional software engineering experience; new graduates are welcome to apply.
* Experience or coursework in prompt engineering, LLM fine\-tuning, or AI workflow orchestration (internship or project experience counts).
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to work collaboratively across functions.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure), containerized deployments (Docker/Kubernetes), or MLOps tooling is a plus.

In this role, you will design and ship AI\-powered features within Zoom's Workforce Engagement Management (WEM) platform, directly improving how enterprise organizations forecast, schedule, and coach their teams. Working alongside experienced engineers, product managers, and data scientists, you will take ownership of features from initial design through production deployment. You will contribute to some of the most forward\-looking work in the WEM space, from LLM\-powered simulation environments to intelligent notification systems and AI\-driven quality scoring pipelines. This is a hands\-on role with meaningful mentorship from senior engineers and real impact on thousands of enterprise users from day one. This is a hybrid position that requires on\-site presence 3 days per week at our San Jose, CA office. Remote arrangements are not available for this role.
